parameter.name: refresh
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Poll interval for power, current, voltage and status values. SMA recommends at least 10 s.

parameter.name: slowRefresh
parameter.label: Slow Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Poll interval for counters, temperatures and diagnostic values.

parameter.name: mppTrackers
parameter.label: Number of DC Inputs
parameter.description: Number of MPP trackers (DC input groups). 0 detects them automatically.
